title: People drawer and table (own branch)
summary:
## Change Map

- `src/people/usePeople.ts`: a new React Query hook listing a tenant's people, paginated.
- `src/people/PersonDrawer.tsx`: a drawer opened from a table row, showing a person's notes.
- `src/people/PeopleTable.tsx`: a DataGrid of people with a last-seen date.

## Summary

The drawer opens before the tenant query settles and crashes the hook; the notes render raw HTML. The rest is test and convention cleanups.
strengths: Tests cover the empty state and the loading skeleton.
The drawer reuses the files page's skeleton instead of a new one.

findings.title: Undefined tenantId crashes the people hook

marks.note: undefined when the drawer opens before the tenant query settles

findings.problem: `tenantId.length` throws when `tenantId` is undefined. The drawer mounts the hook before the tenant query resolves.
findings.why: The person page then shows the error boundary instead of the skeleton, on every first open.
findings.fix: Return early while `tenantId` is undefined, as `useFiles` does three lines above its query: pass `enabled: tenantId !== undefined` to `useQuery`.

diagram.source:
sequenceDiagram
  participant D as PersonDrawer
  participant H as usePeople
  participant Q as tenant query
  D->>H: mount (tenantId undefined)
  H->>Q: fetch tenant
  H--xD: tenantId.length → TypeError
  Q-->>H: settles too late
diagram.caption: The drawer mounts before the tenant query resolves: the hook reads tenantId too early.

findings.title: Person notes rendered as raw HTML

marks.note: note.body comes from the API as the author typed it

findings.problem: A note's body is injected as HTML. Notes are typed by any user of the tenant, so a `` in one runs in every reader's session.
findings.why: Stored XSS on a page that shows the session's token to the API.
findings.fix: Render `note.body` as text, as the previous version did; if rich notes are wanted, go through the `Markdown` component of `src/notes`, which sanitizes.

findings.title: Inline screen queries in the drawer test
findings.problem: Two locators are inline `screen.getBy…` calls instead of entries of the `ui` object.
findings.why: The project's test conventions keep every locator in `ui`, built with `testing-library-selector`, so a test reads as a list of named parts.
findings.fix: Add `notesList: byRole('list', { name: 'Notes' })` and `noteText: (text) => byText(text)` to `ui`, and use them here.

findings.title: Raw pixel spacing in the table styles
findings.problem: `padding` uses raw pixel values where the line below already uses the `Metrics` tokens.
findings.why: The ui-kit's spacing scale is the source of truth; a raw value drifts from it on the next scale change.

findings.title: Duplicated last-seen date formatter
findings.problem: The last-seen cell formats its date inline, as `src/main/utils/formatDate.ts` already does for the files table.
findings.why: Two formatters drift: the files table shows the time zone, this one will not.
